text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out and about with Air Shakur—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur's gaze was fixed on a claw crane game
filled with plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've actually analyzed crane games before.
After all, it's a game that merges digital mechanics with physics.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Going by that experience, you should easily be able
to snag that plushie if you do it right.
choice_data_list: Then I'll give it a try.
Then I'll give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Fine, I'll watch.
Calculate the plushie's center of gravity and the crane's
movement frames while you play."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
